description: Notes folded into the minutes template: discussion per agenda item and reading the meeting notes in order.
precondition: Minutes records with agenda and notes.

cases.return: Empty discussion for every item, no conclusions, no tasks.

preconditions: Records with agenda items 1 "Báo cáo" and 2 "Ngân sách".
cases.inputs: Notes: item 2 "Chốt giá" is listed before the meeting-wide note "Mở đầu".
cases.return: Meeting-wide note comes first, then items in agenda order; item 2 keeps its line under item 2.

preconditions: Records with agenda items 1 "Báo cáo" and 2 "Ngân sách".
cases.return: Conclusions: "- Báo cáo: Duyệt"; nothing is left in the item's discussion.

preconditions: Records with agenda items 1 "Báo cáo" and 2 "Ngân sách".
cases.inputs: Meeting-wide note: "Nhiệm vụ: Gửi biên bản".
cases.return: Tasks: "- Gửi biên bản" (no item prefix).

preconditions: Records with agenda items 1 "Báo cáo" and 2 "Ngân sách".
cases.inputs: Note on item 1: "KẾT LUẬN : Duyệt" (upper case, space before the colon).
cases.return: Recognised as a conclusion: "- Báo cáo: Duyệt".

preconditions: Records with agenda items 1 "Báo cáo" and 2 "Ngân sách".
cases.inputs: Note on item 1: "Kết luận:" with nothing after the colon.
cases.return: Not a conclusion; the line "Kết luận:" stays in item 1's discussion.

preconditions: Records with agenda items 1 "Báo cáo" and 2 "Ngân sách".
cases.inputs: Note on item 1: "Ý kiến: Đồng ý".
cases.return: Opinion mark is only a mark: the whole line "Ý kiến: Đồng ý" stays in the discussion.

preconditions: Records with agenda items 1 "Báo cáo" and 2 "Ngân sách".
cases.inputs: Note on an agenda item that is no longer in the agenda.

preconditions: Records with agenda items 1 "Báo cáo" and 2 "Ngân sách".
cases.return: Lines "a" and "b" kept; blank lines and carriage returns dropped.

preconditions: Records with agenda items 1 "Báo cáo" and 2 "Ngân sách".
cases.inputs: Note line "## Tiêu đề" and "@@ x | y".
cases.return: Marks removed: "Tiêu đề" and "x | y" are plain lines; nothing can turn into a heading or a signature block.
